description: This file contains utility functions for converting the memory format of convolutional layer weights (2D and 3D) in PyTorch modules to optimize performance on CUDA devices, particularly for fp16 data. It includes recursive functions to apply conversions to nested modules and provides detailed documentation and examples.

methods.name: convert_conv2d_weight_memory_format
methods.description: Recursively converts the memory format of Conv2d and ConvTranspose2d weights within a module to the specified memory format, optimizing for CUDA performance.

methods.name: convert_conv3d_weight_memory_format
methods.description: Recursively converts the memory format of Conv3d and ConvTranspose3d weights within a module to the specified memory format, optimizing for CUDA performance.
